angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 980,937 km at 76.22 pc = 0.17 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 13.1203 +/- 0.0162 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 76.22 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.41 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 149026 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 980,937 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.42 +/- 0.33 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 149026 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6179 +/- 15 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 149026 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 149026 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-149026.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.292, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 149026 (pscomppars): spectral type G0, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 149026 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.32 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 149026 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.48, from Carter et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...696..241C/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 149026 (pscomppars): age 2.6 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 149026 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 6 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
